Lekin, agar student pura semester prhne ke liye hai to wo paper repeat kar sakte hain, lekin us ke liye registration limit aur fee ke conditions follow karni padti hain.

results.query: Raging ya bullying ka case kidr ho skta? And what can I do?
gold_facts: Hazing or Raging is strictly prohibited
creates a substantial risk of causing mental or physical harm or humiliation
Discipline Committee is to act as an inquiry committee to investigate reported cases of violation of discipline
results.answer:
Raging ya bullying ka case student discipline committee mein ho sakta hai, especially agar iska koi nasha, mental harm ya physical harm ka koi risk ho. Agar aap kisi student ke saamne bullying ya hazing ka case dekh rahe hain, to aap uss case ko teacher ya staff ke saamne report karein. Agar case serious hai, to teacher ya officer usse student discipline committee tak refer karega. Aap ko sirf evidence aur complaint dene ki zaroorat hai, aur aap uss case mein complainant bhi hona chahiye. Aap ko student discipline committee ke saamne disciplinary hearing mein apni baat sunaane ki opportunity milta hai.  

Is information ko Student_Discipline_Regulations document se liya gaya hai.
